description: Réseau routier départemental - Filaire routier - Département du Puy de Dôme - 2026 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil départemental du Puy-de-Dôme (CD 63). Linear road network under the jurisdiction of the Department of Puy de Dôme. Coverage: Conseil départemental du Puy-de-Dôme (CD 63). The portal shows the English title as "Departmental road network - Road network - Department of Puy de Dôme - 2026" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil départemental du Puy-de-Dôme (CD 63). Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, reseaux-de-transport, puy-de-dome, transport-infrastructure-routier, open-data, reseaux-routiers. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
